document.title: Eval: run producer and graders only in Muse Code
document.summary: The eval harness runs only in Muse Code, with both models defaulting to muse-spark. The Cursor SDK, probe, fallback, and agent flags are gone, and run.ts reads the repo .env for the key.
document.why: Cursor eval runs cost too much, so evals move off Cursor entirely [move off Cursor](source:s3).

sources.label: PR #137
sources.title: Eval: run producer and graders only in Muse Code
sources.gist: Run evals only in Muse Code, drop the Cursor SDK and fallback flags, load .env, simplify the eval workflow and setup notes.

sources.label: ffd116f
sources.gist: Single commit carries the whole change.

sources.label: Agent session · Oct 8
sources.gist: Cursor is too expensive for eval runs, so evals switch fully to Muse.

groups.title: Muse-only producer and graders
groups.why: Evals run only in Muse Code, so the Cursor agent, probe, and fallback go away [muse-only evals](source:s1).
groups.summary: run.ts, producer.ts, and graders.ts call runMuseCodeAgent directly, and the shared result types plus the CLI-hunt check live in musecode.ts.

groups.title: Trimmed eval flags
groups.why: One runner needs two model flags and a login switch, not agent and fallback plumbing.
groups.summary: args.ts drops the agent, fallback, and sandbox flags, and args.test.ts locks the Muse defaults and the rejected flags.

groups.title: Repo .env loading
groups.why: Local runs pick up MUSE_CODE_API_KEY without exporting it by hand [repo .env](source:s1).
groups.summary: env.ts parses the repo .env with the real environment winning, run.ts calls it before reading the key, and env.test.ts covers quotes, comments, and precedence.

groups.title: Model-only reports
groups.why: Summaries name what the run used, and with one runner that is the model id.
groups.summary: result.ts and report.ts drop the agent fields and the fallback hint, and report.test.ts plus the remaining graders.test.ts hunks pin the new output.

groups.title: Muse-only eval workflow
groups.why: CI provisions the CLI the evals run in and skips cleanly without its key [simpler eval.yml](source:s1).
groups.summary: eval.yml installs Muse Code unconditionally, gates on MUSE_CODE_API_KEY, and runs the suite without fallback flags.

groups.title: Muse setup notes
groups.why: Setup notes name the key and CLI the harness actually needs.
groups.summary: AGENTS.md and docs/eval.md point at MUSE_CODE_API_KEY and the muse CLI instead of Cursor.

commits.subject: Eval: run producer and graders only in Muse Code
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- Drop @cursor/sdk, Cursor agent, probe, and fallback flags
- Default producer and grader models to muse-spark-1.3-contributor
- Require MUSE_CODE_API_KEY or --cli-login and load .env
- Simplify eval workflow to install Muse Code only
